<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/orders/{id}"}
#docs
The order as the list shows it, plus every payment attempt (`payments`) and every refund (`refunds`). 404 when the invoice is not an order, or is in another business.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The order's id. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `order`. One of `order`. |
| `id` | `string` | The invoice id. |
| `number` | `string` | The invoice number. |
| `customer` | `object` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `products` | `array of object` | The products on the one-time lines. Credit pack lines are not listed. |
| `total_minor` | `integer` | The invoice total. |
| `currency` | `string` | The order's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `status` | `string` | `due` covers posted, payment_due and not_paid. One of `paid`, `due`, `refunded`, `partly_refunded`. |
| `invoice_status` | `string` | The invoice's own status. |
| `refunded_minor` | `integer` | Succeeded refunds on its payments. |
| `discount_minor` | `integer` | Discounts on the order's lines. |
| `tax_minor` | `integer` | Tax on the order. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the order was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `paid_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the order was paid (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `due_date` | `string · ISO-8601` | The order's due date. |
| `channel` | `string` | api, dashboard, system or import. |
| `payment_method` | `object` | The method of the payment that paid the order, if any. |
| `gateway` | `string` | Gateway of that payment. |
| `coupons` | `array of string` | Codes of the coupons that reduced the order. |
| `created_through` | `object` | What created this record, read from its creation event. `source` is `api`, `dashboard`, `assistant`, `portal`, `checkout`, `webhook`, `mcp`, `scheduled_job`, `migration`, `system` or `hubspot`. `actor` is the member's email for `dashboard`, the gateway key for `webhook`, an API key id for `api`, and null when none applies. Null on the whole object when no creation was recorded. Retrieve only, not on lists. |
| `payments` | `array of object` | The order detail's payments. |
| `refunds` | `array of object` | The order detail's refunds. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such order |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/orders/XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
